stage1.impression: A plausible, well-proportioned deep room with good bones (fir ceiling, record wall, banquette, a long run of small tables) and a believable 28 mm eye-level view, but it still reads as a competent CG interior rather than a night photograph. The floor and the white counter top are the brightest broad surfaces, so the eye goes to grey concrete and zinc instead of the altar. The speakers far back read as small white boxes in black windows, the big globe reads as a black wire cage, the Orbs read as white plates, and the blurred figures read as grey clay mannequins. As it stands a magazine would see a generic dark bar render, not a specific place: the two things that make it specific, Mother EARF and the altar, are the least legible things in the frame.

blocking_9: The altar pair reads at a glance as tinted acrylic horns with light inside them: speaker region [480,280,720,460] lum_median >= 45, with the smoke tint visible rather than white batts in black voids
Mother EARF reads as thick smoked cast acrylic with glowing polished disc edges, not a black wire cage: [610,0,880,285] lum_median 18 to 40 and crush_pct < 5, edges catching light
The light falls in pools on the tables, counter and altar, with the floor and aisle darker than the table tops: floor [300,560,760,800] lum_median <= 55
The zinc counter reads as dark patinated zinc, not white laminate: [0,420,330,490] lum_median <= 80, p95 <= 215
The Orbs read as smoked lamps with a warm inner glow, not flat white discs
The frosted banquette screens glow softly and evenly instead of reading as flat grey-mauve canvases
The blurred guests read as people in real cloth (varied, textured clothing, solid enough at the seat), not translucent grey clay
No unexplained hard-edged shadows on the floor; every shadow has an obvious practical source

defects.what: Altar speakers small and dim (region lum_median 28); they read as white batts and a white horn in black rectangles, the smoked acrylic cabinet itself is invisible against the dark niche; the hero does not read
Mother EARF reads as a black wire or mesh cage lamp (lum_median 8.4, crush 14 %); the 25 mm cast acrylic, its thickness and its polished edges never read
The hard spot's pool on the concrete is a pale slanted smear (lum_median 112, brightest wall patch) with soft blobs, not a legible shadow of the slotted discs; reads as a lighting artefact
Orb lamps read as flat, near-white discs or plates (median 117, p95 221, nearly neutral), not smoked acrylic with a frosted liner glowing
Polished concrete floor is the brightest broad surface (median 69, patch [330,690,520,760] median 91), grey and cool, with hard-edged triangular dark shadows whose source is not visible
Counter top reads as white laminate or marble (median 97, p95 237), not zinc; glassware on it reads small and toy-like
Frosted screen reads as a flat mauve-grey canvas with a vague dark blob (b_median 56 > g 51), not an evenly glowing frosted acrylic panel
Blurred counter guests are uniform grey, untextured, translucent figures; read as clay mannequins rather than motion-blurred people
Banquette guest is a ghost through which the wall shows; no cloth texture
Foreground counter chairs have flat board-like backs cut by the frame edge; the left third foreground is a dark clutter of legs
The counter pendants read as two small bright white cones; no warm pool on the counter beneath them
Fine chroma noise in mid-tones and a slight denoiser smear on the fir boards at 1:1

changes.problem: The altar pair, the hero, is too dim and reads only as white batts in black voids; the smoked cabinets disappear.

evidence.measured: lum_median 28.1 (target >= 45); speakers [505,330,580,435] median 23.6 with p95 228: only the batts and horn are lit, the cabinet and niche are black

change.setting: lamps: the altar spots; lamps on each Ember speaker; haze
change.from: altar 2 x spot 110 W, 2500 K, cone 16 deg; on-speaker area 1.0 W/m2; haze 0.0022/m
change.to: altar 2 x spot 160 W, 2500 K, cone 26 deg aimed to wash the cabinets and the wall behind; on-speaker area 2.5 W/m2 (so light comes through the acrylic edges); add a low warm grazing light on the altar back wall; haze 0.004/m so the altar beams read

changes.expected: The altar becomes the brightest warm pool at the end of the room; cabinet edges and the smoked tint read against a lit back wall rather than black.

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as a black wire cage; nothing tells the eye it is 25 mm cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 8.4, p95 38, crush_pct 13.95; at 1:1 only thin dark lines are visible

change.setting: Mother EARF hard spot, plus one added light
change.from: one hard spot 85 W, cone 30 deg, from [5.4, 2.6, 3.32]
change.to: keep the hard spot for the wall shadow at 85 W but narrow it to cone 20 deg; add a second narrow spot 40 W, 2700 K, cone 12 deg, from the ceiling on the camera side (about [3.5, 1.6, 3.35]) aimed at the globe's centre so the disc faces and polished edges catch light; add a small warm uplight or let a table candle sit under it

changes.expected: The discs read as smoked translucent slabs with bright edge lines; the globe becomes a mid-grey, legible object against the fir ceiling.

changes.problem: The floor and aisle are the brightest broad surfaces and carry hard unexplained shadows, so the room reads lit from the front, not by its practicals.

evidence.measured: lum_median 69 (frame median 37); patch [330,690,520,760] median 91; triangular hard shadows with a 24 px edge

change.setting: the light that lights the front floor (street lamps / sink spot / the Mother spot's spill) and the floor's polish
change.from: street lamps 0 W, sink spot 18 W cone 30 deg; floor polish as now
change.to: find and cut the source casting the triangular floor shadows (probably the Mother spot's spill or the sink spot): sink spot 8 W, cone 20 deg; lower the floor's specular (roughness up about 0.15) and darken its tone by about 20 %

changes.expected: The floor drops below the table tops; pools on tables and counter read, and the stray hard shadows vanish.

changes.problem: The zinc counter top reads as white laminate.

evidence.measured: lum_median 97.4, p95 237, near neutral (r108 g96 b94)

change.to: darker aged zinc: base about 40 % darker, roughness 0.35 to 0.45 with mottled patina and wipe marks, so the Dome downlights make soft pools rather than lighting it all

changes.expected: A dark grey counter with warm pools under each pendant and small highlights on glasses.

changes.problem: The Orbs read as flat white discs, not smoked lamps glowing from within.

evidence.measured: lum_median 117, p95 221, near neutral (r132 g112 b106); a near disc [740,450,780,480] median 150

change.setting: each Orb's power and glow; the frosted acrylic's roughness
change.to: Orb 0.6 W at 2200 K, glow 0.01, and the light reaching the Orb faces from the room reduced (see c3) so the faces are lit from within; frosted liner roughness up so it reads diffuse

changes.expected: Each Orb reads as a warm amber-in-smoke glow with a small warm pool on its table top.

changes.problem: The frosted banquette screens read as flat mauve-grey canvases rather than glowing frosted acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 52.8, lum_range 75, b_median 56 > g_median 51 (a cool magenta cast); screen [885,160,930,400] median 34

change.setting: the screens' images (emission strength) and colour; grade
change.to: screens 0.035 with a warm 2700 K bias so they read as soft warm glows, evenly lit edge to edge

changes.expected: Soft, even glow behind the banquette, neutral-warm, framing the seated guest in silhouette.

changes.problem: The blurred guests read as translucent grey clay figures.

evidence.measured: uniform grey, no cloth texture; the banquette guest [880,380,980,600] is see-through

change.from: shutter 1.0 frame, seated head travel [0.16, 0.09, 0.03] m, turn 30 deg
change.to: seated guests' body still, head travel [0.06, 0.03, 0.01] m and turn 15 deg (only the head and hands blur); keep the bartender's pour blurred; give each person a different darker clothing tone so they are not all mid-grey

changes.expected: Solid seated silhouettes with a soft blur only at the head and hands, as in a real quarter-second exposure.

changes.problem: Fine chroma noise and slight denoiser smear on the fir at 1:1.

evidence.measured: visible colour speckle in the beams and wall at 3x crop

changes.expected: Clean mid-tones; grain left only as intended film grain.

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar pair larger in frame or bring the camera closer to the altar
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes this frame as the whole room seen from the door; the speakers are inevitably small at 28 mm from x 1.9, which caps how much of a hero they can be in this shot.

out_of_scope.request: Redesign the foreground counter chairs' flat backs
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed by the room's design.

out_of_scope.request: Give the frame a saturated accent colour
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration makes every product grey; colour comes only from the products, which are fixed.
